text.en:
Item (9), page 588, paragraph "am," for the Province of Palawan, section two of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred, is amended to read as follows:
"(9) Construction of building for industrial shop, Bintuan Barrio School, Coron ₱4,000.00."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
